note_en: Setana town's published public-enterprise analysis tables (electricity business, wind; xlsx): FY2024 (Apr 2024–Mar 2025) generation 3 MWh (FY2020–2023: 2,277, 3,375, 3,321 and 694 MWh); the analysis says units 1 and 2 were hardly running and the FIT revenue ratio is 0 because it is not generating; FIT end date 31 Dec 2023, power-sales contract end 31 Mar 2025; the FY2023 table says unit 2 cannot be restored and only unit 1 ran, output-limited. item: 8. Korea: Ulsan 750 kW floating demo ever installed?
proposal: drop('KOR', 'Ulsan Dongbu floating demo (Vindmøllen 750 kW)', C, '蔚山 750 kW 浮動式示範機從未在海上安裝：2019 年 11 月蔚州郡四度退回細部設計、無法下海；2025 年政府的風電研發企畫報告說 750 kW 浮動式實證「曾嘗試」、因取得實證海域困難而受阻，2025 年 9 月 KISTEP 報告說韓國沒有浮動式離岸風電的運送安裝實例', 'The Ulsan 750 kW floating demonstrator was never installed at sea: in November 2019 Ulju County had rejected its detailed design four times; the government’s 2025 wind R&D planning report says a 750 kW floating demonstration was “attempted” and held back by the difficulty of securing a test site, and a KISTEP report of September 2025 says Korea has no case of transporting and installing floating offshore wind', 'https://www.kistep.re.kr/boardDownload.es?bid=0067&list_no=94369&seq=1')  (replaces the existing fix(..., st=2, year=0, note=True) on this record)
note_zh: 慶尚日報 2019-11-05：原訂 10 月進入實證的 750 kW 浮動式試驗機停擺，蔚州郡四度退回實施設計。KISTEP 2019 年預備可行性報告：「建設前階段」、尚未下海且不含併網。韓國能源技術評估院 2025 年度風電研發企畫報告：「國內曾嘗試 750 kW 級浮動式實證……因實證地點取得問題而進行困難」。KISTEP 2025-09-26 議題報告（KRISO 作者）：「國內浮動式離岸風電沒有運送、安裝實例」。之後也查不到任何下海、發電的報導。結論：從未在海上建成，建議刪除。
note_en: Kyongsang Ilbo (5 Nov 2019): the 750 kW floating pilot that should have entered sea trials in October was stalled after Ulju County rejected the detailed design four times. KISTEP's 2019 feasibility report: “pre-construction”, not yet at sea and without grid connection. KETEP's 2025 wind R&D planning report: a 750 kW floating demonstration “was attempted” in Korea and has had difficulty because of securing a test site. KISTEP issue paper of 26 Sep 2025 (KRISO author): Korea has no case of transport and installation of floating offshore wind. No report of deployment or generation exists. Conclusion: never built at sea; drop.

item: 9. Korea: Gunsan KEPRI Doosan 3 MW on suction bucket
proposal: (missing) A real offshore demonstrator with no record: KEPCO Research Institute (KEPRI) Gunsan Port suction-bucket demonstrator, 1 x Doosan WinDS3000 3 MW (rotor 134 m per GlobalData) on a tripod suction-bucket foundation in the sea at Gunsan Port, installed October 2016. No citable coordinates and no source on current operation.
note_zh: 電力專刊《일렉트릭파워》（2021-08-09，KEPRI 副院長訪談）：電力研究院 2016 年 10 月在群山港成功以吸力式桶型基礎設置 3 MW 級離岸風機 1 部；基礎由 에드벡트 設計製造，「群山外海的 3 MW 離岸風機」。GlobalData（power-technology）：Gunsan Port – KEPRI Suction Bucket Demonstrator，3 MW 離岸，2016 年商轉，斗山 1 部 WinD3000/134。所以是在海上（港內水域），不是陸上；荷蘭 RVO 說裝在陸上不對。資料裡沒有任何紀錄涵蓋它（群山附近只有 GEM 的 Gogunsan 陸域規劃案）。OSM 在 35.972 N、126.515 E 與 35.969 N、126.515 E 有兩個業者為「한국전력공사 전력연구원」、附航標燈的風機節點，但標 1.5 MW、2017-07 起，與「1 部 3 MW、2016-10」不符，未採用為座標。現況（是否仍運轉）查不到。
note_en: Electric Power Journal (9 Aug 2021, interview with KEPRI's deputy head): KEPRI installed one 3 MW-class offshore turbine on its suction-bucket foundation at Gunsan Port in October 2016; the foundation was designed and built by Advect, the firm that built “the 3 MW offshore turbine off Gunsan”. GlobalData (power-technology): Gunsan Port – KEPRI Suction Bucket Demonstrator, 3 MW offshore, commissioned 2016, one Doosan WinD3000/134. So it stands in the sea (port waters), not on land as RVO put it. No record covers it (the only nearby record is GEM's onshore pipeline Gogunsan). OSM has two KEPRI-operated turbine nodes with navigation lights at 35.972 N 126.515 E and 35.969 N 126.515 E, but tagged 1.5 MW each from July 2017, which does not match one 3 MW unit from October 2016, so they are not used for a position. Current operating status unknown.
why: No citable coordinates (OSM nodes unnamed and inconsistent) and no source on whether it still runs; cyber.kepco.co.kr newsletter fails TLS (SSLV3 handshake) and mdpi.com returns 403.

item: 11b. Korea: Yeonggwang Wind intertidal 15 units position
proposal: Replace the existing fix('KOR', 'Yeonggwang Wind offshore wind farm', G, ...) with: fix('KOR', 'Yeonggwang Wind offshore wind farm', G, '靈光風電（35 部、79.6 MW）中立在潮間帶的 15 部 2.3 MW＝34.5 MW；座標改為 OpenStreetMap 風場關係「영광 해상풍력」（relation 17551812，15 部營運者영광풍력발전的 2.3 MW 風機）的中心，北緯 35.259°、東經 126.326°（© OpenStreetMap 貢獻者）；GEM 原座標是公司登記地址', 'The 15 × 2.3 MW turbines (34.5 MW) that stand in the intertidal zone of the Yeonggwang Wind complex (35 turbines, 79.6 MW); the point moves to the centre of the OpenStreetMap wind-farm relation “영광 해상풍력” (relation 17551812: 15 turbines of 2.3 MW operated by 영광풍력발전), 35.259 N, 126.326 E (© OpenStreetMap contributors); GEM’s point was the company’s registered address', 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/17551812', mw=34.5, turbine='15 x Unison U113 2.3 MW', lat=35.259, lon=126.326, note=True)
note_zh: OpenStreetMap relation 17551812：name「영광 해상풍력」、site=wind_farm、start_date 2018-09-01、成員 15 個，全是營運者「영광풍력발전」、2.3 MW 的風機節點（另外 20 部 2.255 MW 的 영광풍력발전 風機不在這個關係裡），正好對應 etnews 說的潮間帶 15 部 2.3 MW。15 部範圍北緯 35.242–35.280°、東經 126.320–126.333°，中心 35.259、126.326；原 GEM 點（公司地址，35.279、126.336）偏北約 2.3 km。
note_en: OpenStreetMap relation 17551812: name “영광 해상풍력” (Yeonggwang offshore wind), site=wind_farm, start_date 2018-09-01, 15 members, all turbine nodes of 2.3 MW operated by 영광풍력발전 (the company's 20 turbines of 2.255 MW are not in it), matching the 15 intertidal 2.3 MW units in the etnews source. The 15 span 35.242–35.280 N, 126.320–126.333 E; centre 35.259, 126.326; GEM's point (the company address, 35.279, 126.336) is about 2.3 km north.
